evan: Planning a short rolling maintenance in us-west2 (night window) Tue 23:00-02:00 PT. Cause: thermal-gradient alarms + inter-rack coax cable replacement flagged by telemetry. Scope: 5 racks across two pods. Objective: replace suspect coax links, reboot affected NICs, validate thermal balance and NVML metrics. Reserved pools unaffected.

tara: How much capacity do we expect to lose? Any parallel cohorts?

evAN: Typo: evan :) Expect ~7% shared capacity if we do two-rack overlap; prefer single-rack serial cohorts to keep impact <4%. Canary on rack-2 at 23:10 (4 nodes).

li: Recommend seeding KV and model caches 45m before start. Also pause large embeddings and bulk eval jobs 22:30-03:30.

evAN: Will pause jobs and tag maintenance. @sre-bot please create ticket and ping data-platform.

sre-bot: Maintenance ticket created: us-west2-coax-thermal-6555555555. Link: https://console.internal/maint/6555555555 (automated).

mike: Network note: replacing coax may transiently change link metrics; be ready to rollback to previous NIC driver if flapping. Watch CRC errors and retransmit rate.

li: Cost/backfill plan: prefer intra-region spare nodes in us-west2; if we need to borrow (rare) from us-east, estimate cost ~ $1k for 12 nodes x 3h. Only do that if p95 +300ms or error +0.5%.

evAN: Runbook snippet for ops during the window: 
```bash
# cordon and drain example nodes
kubectl cordon node-usw2-r02{01..04} -n inference
kubectl drain node-usw2-r02{01..04} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=240 -n inference
# check link CRC/errors
ssh ops@node-usw2-r020 "ethtool -S eth0 | egrep 'crc|rx_errors|tx_errors'"
# apply NIC soft-restart
ssh ops@node-usw2-r020 "sudo ethtool -r eth0 || sudo systemctl restart nic-driver"
```

mike: Please include a 12-minute manual approval between canary and next rack. We had a regression once with fast rollouts.

evAN: Added manual hold + automated checks (p95, error rate, CRC delta). Lia will monitor ML perf, Mike net, Tara infra-watch. Ops leads please ACK.

tara: ACK

li: ACK

mike: ACK

evAN: I'll draft a short customer blurb for shared tenants and schedule the canary. Moving to final schedule unless objections. :white_check_mark:
